ci-bot: Build #7234 failed on branch main — flaky test: TestHeartbeatScheduler
ci-bot: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7234/artifacts/heartbeat_test.log
maria: saw this — flaky? :thinking:
sam: yep saw intermittent failures earlier today, usually on macOS runners
alex: re-running job now
ci-bot: Re-run triggered by alex (job 7234 -> 7234.1)
ci-bot: Re-run passed
maria: passing on rerun doesn't help, need bisect
sam: can someone capture the failing output and stack? @jin any logs in artifact bucket?
jin: grabbing logs, link in a sec
jin: artifact: gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/7234/heartbeat_test.log
alex: pasted the failing snippet:
```
--- FAIL: TestHeartbeatScheduler (0.12s)
    heartbeat_test.go:87: expected tick 3 but got 2
    scheduler.go:214: schedule drift exceeded: 45ms
```
alex: repro locally with:
```
go test ./runtime -run TestHeartbeatScheduler -count=50
```
alex: I can repro once in ~50 runs without -race
nate: might be timer jitter; tests assume strict ordering of ticks
maria: can we temporarily quarantine the test so CI doesn't mask other flakes? :+1:
sam: +1, open a quarantine PR that skips on CI for now
maria: filed issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/981 "flake: TestHeartbeatScheduler jitter on CI"
maria: adding quarantine PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1982
jin: note: macOS runners show higher jitter, linux less so
alex: trying patch: replace time.Now() with monotonic clock and tighten tolerance
alex: snippet
```
if time.Since(lastTick) > expected+50*time.Millisecond {
    t.Fatalf(\"schedule drift exceeded: %v\", delta)
}
```
alex: maybe bump to 100ms while we root cause
sam: suggestion: add a retry loop in test instead of strict assert, or use testclock fake
nate: long term: move to deterministic test clock; short term: quarantine + add flaky label
maria: assigning to @alex to push a minimal fix. @sam to bisect if it keeps failing
alex: will send patch and add a comment in the issue
maria: thanks. can we schedule a 30min triage tomorrow 10:30am to decide followups? :calendar:
sam: I'll join
jin: me too
nate: if someone gets a failing run, post the full log here and we'll trigger a bisect
maria: closing for now — keeping thread pinned to the issue
